_comment: Spike 007 · committed per-solution SKELETON. First-party ConnectionReferences carry a static LogicalName + ConnectorId; ConnectionId is left blank and injected per-target from the app's client_payload.bindings by gen-deployment-settings.sh. Custom-connector refs (see the last entry) carry an env-specific ConnectorId that the binding overrides per target. EnvironmentVariables are the solution's per-env config (separate from GitHub Actions variables).

ConnectionReferences._comment: custom-connector ref: ConnectorId is env-specific (shared_<uniquename>-<suffix>) and LogicalName is hashed — the binding supplies BOTH per target; cert-auth connections bind identically by ConnectionId (pre-provisioned out-of-band).
